title: Add microservice RAG blueprint with sandboxed tool-calling and CI smoke tests
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds a production-adjacent microservice RAG blueprint with a local sandbox, telemetry examples, and a fast GitHub Actions smoke test to help teams evaluate tenant isolation and tool-calling patterns.
body: Motivation: Provide a compact, deployable reference that demonstrates how to build a multi-service RAG pipeline with tenant-aware routing, a sandboxed tool-calling surface, and minimal operational telemetry. What this PR adds: a new examples/microservice-rag blueprint that includes a router service, retriever service, inference-proxy service, a local DevSandbox (docker-compose) for iterative development, an example vector-store fixture, an OTEL-based telemetry config and a lightweight GitHub Actions smoke workflow that runs a short indexing+query scenario. It also contains a step-by-step README, troubleshooting tips, and SDK snippets for TypeScript and Go. Key constraints and decisions: the sandbox is intentionally opinionated and not production-ready (secrets are env-driven), the inference-proxy demonstrates both streaming and structured-output examples, and the CI smoke test is designed to run in under 3 minutes on GitHub runners to prevent flakiness. Checklist: [x] example services and scaffold || [x] local docker-compose sandbox || [x] docs quickstart and troubleshooting || [x] CI smoke workflow || [x] telemetry config and example queries || [x] basic smoke fixtures and tests. Related work: ENG-12900 (blueprint initiative), PM-445 (onboarding playbooks), SUP-8891 (customer-driven example request). Migration / rollout notes: this is additive and lives in examples; no infra changes required. How to evaluate: follow README steps to start the sandbox, run the smoke workflow locally, and verify sample Grafana dashboard snapshots in telemetry/README.

Add router, retriever, inference-proxy service stubs and docker-compose for DevSandbox
Add sample vector fixtures and quick CI smoke workflow (.github/workflows/rag-smoke.yml)
Add telemetry config and sample Grafana dashboard JSON

Docs: expand quickstart, add SDK snippets for TS and Go and usage notes
review_comments: Arjun Patel: Looks good overall. Please add a short note on tenant key rotation and KMS integration in troubleshooting. Asked for a tiny unit test for the router dispatch logic.
Maya Chen (author): Added KMS note and a small table-driven test for dispatch in router/main_test.go. Updated doc with sample KMS env snippet.
Sofia Martinez: CI smoke workflow seems tight for GH runners; can we reduce indexing dataset further and add retry logic to the smoke test step?
Maya Chen: Reduced fixture size and added retry wrapper to run-smoke.sh; also added a 2s backoff and overall timeout to keep runs <3m.
Liam O'Connor: Telemetry config looks good; one request to make exporter URL configurable via env and document sampling settings. Approved after that change.
Maya Chen: Made exporter url env-driven and documented default sampling settings. Marking changes as addressed.
SRE team (comment): ran the smoke workflow in a fork and observed intermittent lint failure on the TypeScript example. Fixed lint rule and re-ran.
Automated CI: initial smoke tests failed on first run due to network timing; workflow rerun passed.
ci_checks: smoke-tests: fail on first run -> rerun -> pass
merge_details: Merged via squash by Maya Chen on 2025-02-18. Squash commit message: add microservice rag blueprint, sandbox, and ci smoke tests. Backported a doc fix to release/2025-02 branch and added a follow-up issue for a hosted-demo variant.
notes_for_maintainers: This example is intended to be self-contained. When updating, keep the smoke workflow under 3 minutes. If adding telemetry changes, include a saved dashboard JSON and update telemetry/README. Avoid committing secrets; use .env.example for variables.
observability_examples: otel-collector-config.yaml and a sample Grafana dashboard are included under examples/microservice-rag/telemetry to demonstrate end-to-end traces for a single query path.
testing_instructions: Follow README steps to bring up the DevSandbox via docker-compose up -d, then run make smoke-local or .github/workflows/rag-smoke.yml via act or a forked GH Actions run. Verify sample queries return expected structured output and check telemetry traces under /telemetry/dashboard-sample.json.
